name: Exhibits and Attachments Review
summary: Verify that all exhibits and attachments are properly listed, referenced within the document body, and correctly labeled
purpose: Verify that all exhibits and attachments are properly listed, referenced within the document body, and correctly labeled. Documents with missing references or unlabeled exhibits fail attachment completeness standards.
assignment_instructions:
You are evaluating a document draft for exhibit and attachment completeness.

Given the document draft, perform the following:
1. Extract ALL exhibits and attachments — these may be labeled as "Exhibit A", "Attachment 1", "Appendix I", or similar.
2. For each exhibit/attachment, record its label, description, and whether it is referenced in the body of the document.
3. Check if every exhibit/attachment listed has at least one in-body reference.
4. Check if labels follow a consistent format (e.g., all "Exhibit X" or all "Attachment N").

Return a single JSON object with this exact structure:
{
  "assignment_id": "doc_exhibits_attachments_v1",
  "agent_summary": "One sentence summary",
  "inputs_used": ["list of inputs examined"],
  "missing_inputs": ["any missing inputs"],
  "claims": [
    {"claim": "", "evidence_reference": "", "confidence": "provided | inferred | missing"}
  ],
  "exhibits": [
    {"label": "", "description": "", "referenced_in_body": true, "body_reference_location": ""}
  ],
  "attachments_referenced_in_body": true,
  "all_labels_consistent": true,
  "total_exhibits": 0,
  "referenced_count": 0,
  "unreferenced_count": 0,
  "calculations": [
    {"name": "reference_ratio", "formula": "referenced_count / total_exhibits", "inputs": {}, "result": 0.0, "units": "ratio", "assumptions": []}
  ],
  "risks": [
    {"risk": "", "severity": "low | medium | high", "evidence_reference": ""}
  ],
  "assumptions": [],
  "open_questions": [],
  "final_output": "PASS or FAIL",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}

Scoring rules:
- reference_ratio = referenced_count / total_exhibits
- attachments_referenced_in_body must be true if ALL exhibits are referenced in the body
- all_labels_consistent must be true if all exhibit labels follow the same naming convention
- PASS if total_exhibits >= 0 AND attachments_referenced_in_body == true AND all_labels_consistent == true
- FAIL if any exhibit is not referenced in the body OR labels are inconsistent
- If no exhibits exist (total_exhibits == 0), final_output should be PASS with a note

Return only the JSON. No markdown fences, no prose. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
